BUSINESS OVERVIEW

EDF Power Solutions North America develops, owns, and operates utility-scale wind, solar, and battery-storage infrastructure across the United States and Canada and also provides construction, operations, maintenance, and asset-management services.

Public transaction materials report 5.6 GW of net installed capacity at March 31, 2026 and a 19.2 GW development pipeline. EDF remains the current legal owner. KKR signed a definitive agreement on June 30, 2026 to acquire the U.S. and Canadian operations through KKR Global Infrastructure Investors V, but no legal closing was identified through September 1, 2026, so KKR is recorded only as pending incoming.

STORY TIMELINE
Aug 2026

Canadian competition clearance was reported and a New York regulatory proceeding remained pending; no legal closing was identified.

Jun 30, 2026
Acquisition

EDF and KKR signed a definitive agreement for KKR to acquire the U.S. and Canadian operations, subject to customary closing conditions.

May 8, 2025

EDF Renewables North America and EDF International Division Americas adopted the EDF power solutions brand.

BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Helix Digital Infrastructure is a KKR-owned platform established to finance, develop, deliver, own, operate, and manage the data centers, power, transmission, fiber, and connectivity required by hyperscale artificial-intelligence customers. The platform launched publicly in June 2026 with more than US$10 billion of long-duration capital commitments and a dedicated leadership team. Helix Digital Infrastructure LLC directly states that it is wholly owned by KKR & Co. Inc. KIA, NVIDIA, and Vistra participate as strategy-level investors or partners rather than direct LLC owners; their interests are not counted as separate company ownership periods.

STORY TIMELINE
Jun 11, 2026
Financing

KKR launched Helix Digital Infrastructure with more than US$10 billion of committed capital to finance and deliver AI data-center, power, and connectivity infrastructure.

Dec 31, 2025
Founding

A KKR subsidiary exhibit identified Helix Digital Infrastructure LLC and the related Helix investment-vehicle architecture.

BUSINESS OVERVIEW

This descriptive portfolio grouping covers the two target holdcos in TotalEnergies' December 2025 sale of parallel 50% interests to KKR-managed insurance vehicles and accounts.

The underlying North American portfolio comprises approximately 1.4 GW of operating utility-scale and distributed solar assets in the United States and Canada, including six utility-scale assets and 41 distributed-generation assets. TotalEnergies retained 50%, joint control and the operator role; KKR acquired the other 50%. The two holdcos, JVPTR acquisition vehicle and underlying project entities are embedded in this single record rather than counted as separate portfolio companies.

STORY TIMELINE
Dec 16, 2025
Investment

The 50% sale closed, leaving TotalEnergies and KKR-managed vehicles as equal co-owners while TotalEnergies remained operator.

Sep 29, 2025
Investment

TotalEnergies agreed to sell 50% of an approximately 1.4 GW operating solar portfolio in the United States and Canada to KKR-managed insurance vehicles and accounts.

Nov-Dec 2025
Financing

Merger-control and U.S. energy-regulatory approvals identified the two target holdcos and cleared 50/50 joint control.
